title: Police shattered man's liver
article: A man shot by police during a standoff last year could have lived up to an hour after the fatal shot was fired, a coroner's jury heard Monday.
_David_ _Melzer_ was killed last June after an 11-hour standoff and shootout with city police at his parents' home.

The forensic pathologist who performed the autopsy on _Melzer_ told the inquest the bullet fired by a police sharpshooter destroyed _Melzer_'s liver but there was no way he could have survived the wound.
And Dr. Betty Chow, a forensic toxicologist, testified _Melzer_'s blood-alcohol level at the time of his death was 2 1/2 times above the legal limit to operate a vehicle.
